basic_details.job_title: SXC Jaipur AI Research & Engineering Intern Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: ANA Advisory, a private company, is inviting applications for the post of AI Research & Engineering Intern in its Engineering & AI Department, at a stipend of Rs 10,000 per month. The internship is open to BCA students and is notified by St. Xavier's College Jaipur through its Training, Internship and Placement Cell (TIPC). The location is Jaipur / Remote (as applicable). Applications are made through a Google Form, and the last date is 18 November 2026 till 1:00 PM.

how_to_apply: Open the Application Form at https://forms.gle/XxS4VaPixsPa9V1o8.
important_instructions: Apply only if you possess the required technical fundamentals and genuine interest in AI engineering. Ensure your resume highlights relevant technical skills and AI/ML projects. Provide an active GitHub profile and relevant project links wherever available. For further details, contact Dr. Renu Jadon (TIPC Coordinator), Dr. Arpita Banerjee (TIPC Assistant Coordinator) or Ms. Sonali Dubey (TPO, TIPC) at [email protected]. College contact numbers printed on the notice: +91 9828726366 / 9571077348; college email: [email protected].

rows.details: ANA Advisory (private company; notice issued by St. Xavier's College Jaipur)

content_sections.heading: About ANA Advisory Internship
content_sections.text: The notice is issued on the letterhead of St. Xavier's College Jaipur, Nevta - Mahapura Road, Jaipur - 302029, Rajasthan, which is affiliated to the University of Rajasthan, Jaipur. It informs BCA students of an internship with ANA Advisory for those interested in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and advanced AI engineering. The internship gives practical exposure to building, evaluating and deploying reliable AI systems for financial technology workflows.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice is addressed to BCA students. The notice does not print any other educational qualification, experience requirement or age limit. Candidates should possess: Strong fundamentals in Python programming and Data Structures & Algorithms. Understanding of Machine Learning, Neural Networks and Transformers. Familiarity with APIs, SQL, Git and debugging. Ability to explain at least one hands-on AI/ML project and its outcomes. Preferred additional skills: PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, FAISS, Qdrant, Redis, Kafka, cloud infrastructure and MCP/A2A. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the full eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: ANA Advisory Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will get hands-on exposure to: Python Programming, Data Structures & Algorithms Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Neural Networks Small Language Models (SLM) and Large Language Models (LLM) Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Multi-Agent Systems, MCP and A2A Production-Grade AI Systems and Deployment APIs, Databases, Docker and Cloud Infrastructure AI System Scalability, Reliability and Performance Optimisation Expected internship outcomes: interns will work towards developing a source-cited RAG prototype, evaluating AI model accuracy and latency, building agent integrations, packaging tested AI APIs and documenting system reliability, security and scalability.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ANA Advisory Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Application Form at https://forms.gle/XxS4VaPixsPa9V1o8 . Submit your updated resume. Submit your GitHub profile. Submit 1–2 project links. Apply by 18 November 2026, 1:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises four stages, in this order: Resume and GitHub Profile Review Python/DSA and AI Discussion Practical RAG/LLM Assignment Final Discussion The notice does not give dates or the mode for these stages.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Apply only if you possess the required technical fundamentals and genuine interest in AI engineering. Ensure your resume highlights relevant technical skills and AI/ML projects. Provide an active GitHub profile and relevant project links wherever available. For further details, contact Dr. Renu Jadon (TIPC Coordinator), Dr. Arpita Banerjee (TIPC Assistant Coordinator) or Ms. Sonali Dubey (TPO, TIPC) at [email protected] . College contact numbers printed on the notice: +91 9828726366 / 9571077348; college email: [email protected] .
